recent_posts.title: A real AI application for automation testing — Stabilise your automation tests with Retrieval Augmented Generation for selectors
recent_posts.summary: A practical approach to stabilizing automation test selectors using Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) with Large Language Models. The method involves storing selector data, capturing screenshots and DOM scans, creating robust prompts for LLMs to generate stable selectors, and implementing retry logic. The solution addresses common test automation challenges like flaky selectors that break due to UI changes, using AI to dynamically find elements based on natural language descriptions rather than brittle XPath or ID selectors.

recent_posts.title: Advanced React architecture patterns for senior developers
recent_posts.summary: Explores advanced React architecture patterns used by senior developers, including Compound Component Architecture for managing shared state without prop drilling, Prop Getters for creating reusable component interactions, and strategic decisions between controlled vs uncontrolled components. These patterns help create maintainable, scalable applications with cleaner APIs and better code organization.

recent_posts.title: Client side PDF processing with @opendocsg/pdf2md eliminates server costs
recent_posts.summary: A developer shares their experience building a PDF chat app and discovering @opendocsg/pdf2md, a JavaScript library that processes PDFs entirely in the browser. The solution eliminates server-side processing costs and infrastructure complexity that typically plague enterprise PDF processing systems. The library converts PDFs to markdown client-side, offering 3-5x faster conversion times with zero server costs. The author provides a complete React implementation and argues this approach could save enterprises millions in PDF processing infrastructure costs.

recent_posts.title: Maximizing the impact of transactional email for startup success
recent_posts.summary: Transactional emails are critical for user engagement, retention, and growth in startups. Common pitfalls include poor deliverability and using shared IPs, which can significantly impact user experience and conversions. Ensuring proper domain verification, avoiding shared IPs, monitoring bounce and spam rates, and warming up new sending domains are essential steps. Choosing the right email provider, writing effective emails, and leveraging email analytics can greatly improve email performance. Treating emails as a growth channel rather than a backend task can provide a competitive advantage.

recent_posts.title: Introducing the “30 Days of 30 Projects” Challenge
recent_posts.summary: The '30 Days of 30 Projects' Challenge is an initiative by GIAIC to enhance students' coding skills through daily project-based learning. The challenge, led by a Student Ambassador and supported by GIAIC faculty, focuses on using technologies like Next.js, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, and Shadcn-ui. Participants will gain hands-on experience, build a portfolio of 30 mini-projects, and engage with a community of over 30,000 tech students. Prerequisites include basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and TypeScript. Detailed guides for setting up and configuring projects are provided, along with instructions for project structure, routing, styling, and deployment.
